exams.title: 小学英语三年级上册 期中测试卷

questions.stem: 选出不同类的一项：（　）
questions.analysis: red、blue、green 都是颜色，book 是物品，所以选 C。

questions.stem: 早上见到老师，你应该说：（　）
questions.analysis: 早上问好用 Good morning；Good night 是晚上睡前道别，Goodbye 是再见。

questions.stem:
读对话，回答问题。
Sarah: Hello! I'm Sarah.
Mike: Hi, Sarah. I'm Mike.
Sarah: I have a ruler. What about you?
Mike: I have a pencil.
（1）Who has a ruler?（2）What does Mike have?
questions.analysis: 答案都能在对话中找到：Sarah 说自己有 ruler，Mike 说自己有 pencil。

questions.stem:
抄写下面的句子，注意大小写和标点：
hello! i'm wu yifan.
questions.analysis: 句首字母和专有名词（人名）首字母要大写，I 永远大写，句末用感叹号。

exams.title: 小学英语三年级上册 期末测试卷

questions.stem:
— How many plates?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: How many 问数量，要用数字回答；Yes/No 回答不了数量问题。

questions.stem: 把东西递给别人时，应该说：（　）
questions.analysis: Here you are 意为“给你”，是递东西时的固定用语。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
This is my family. This is my father. He is tall. This is my mother. She is nice. I love my family.
（1）Who is tall?（2）Does the writer love the family?
questions.analysis: 第一处 He is tall 指 father；最后一句 I love my family 说明答案是肯定的。

questions.stem:
抄写下面的句子，注意大小写和标点：
this is my mother . she is nice .
questions.answer: This is my mother. She is nice.
questions.analysis: 每句首字母大写，句号后要有空格，句末标点不能丢。

exams.title: 小学英语三年级下册 期中测试卷

questions.stem: 选出不同类的一项：（　）
questions.analysis: father、mother、brother 都是家庭成员，desk 是书桌。

questions.stem: 向别人介绍你的朋友 Amy，应该说：（　）
questions.analysis: 介绍他人用 This is...；B 意思是“她是 Amy 的朋友”，C 是疑问句，都不符合。

questions.stem:
读对话，回答问题。
Amy: Look at the elephant. It has a long nose.
Tom: Yes. And it has a short tail.
（1）What animal is it?（2）Does it have a long nose?
questions.analysis: 第一句点明是 elephant；has a long nose 说明答案是肯定的。

questions.stem:
抄写下面的句子，注意大小写和标点：
look at the monkey ! it is so funny .
questions.answer: Look at the monkey! It is so funny.
questions.analysis: 感叹号后新句子首字母要大写，注意 funny 的拼写。

exams.title: 小学英语三年级下册 期末测试卷

questions.stem:
— Do you like pears?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: Do you...? 的肯定回答是 Yes, I do.；用 am 回答的是 Are you...? 的问句。

questions.stem:
— Where is my ruler?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: Where 问地点，要用表示位置的短语回答；B 答颜色，C 答物品，都不对。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
I have a new bag. It's blue and white. There are five books and two pencils in it. I like my bag very much.
（1）What colour is the bag?（2）How many books are there in the bag?
questions.analysis: 颜色和数量都能在文中直接找到，注意 five books 与 two pencils 不要混。

questions.stem:
抄写下面的句子，注意大小写和标点：
how many kites can you see ?
questions.answer: How many kites can you see?
questions.analysis: 疑问句首字母大写，句末用问号，can you see 的语序不能颠倒。

exams.title: 小学英语四年级上册 期中测试卷

questions.stem: Let ______ clean the blackboard.（　）
questions.analysis: let 后面接人称代词宾格，I 的宾格是 me。

questions.stem: 你想请别人帮忙，可以说：（　）
options: Excuse me. Can you help me?
questions.analysis: Excuse me 用于引起注意，Can you help me? 是请求帮助；B 是回应感谢，C 是初次见面用语。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
This is my classroom. It's big and bright. There are forty desks and forty chairs in it. The teacher's desk is near the blackboard. We clean the classroom every day.
（1）How many desks are there in the classroom?（2）Where is the teacher's desk?
questions.analysis: 数字与位置信息都能在文中定位，注意 forty 与 fourteen 不要混淆。

questions.stem: 连词成句：is / this / classroom / my / .
questions.analysis: 英语句子顺序一般是“主语+谓语+其他”，This 开头，句末加句号。

exams.title: 小学英语四年级上册 期末测试卷

questions.stem:
— What's in your schoolbag?
— ______（　）
options: Three books and a pencil box.
questions.analysis: 问书包里有什么，应回答物品；A 只答了一件，B 更完整；C 答的是颜色。

questions.stem: My friend ______ long hair and big eyes.（　）
questions.analysis: 主语 My friend 是第三人称单数，用 has；have 用于第一、二人称或复数。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
My name is Jack. I'm ten. I have a good friend. His name is Tom. He is tall and strong. He likes sports. We often play football after school.
（1）How old is Jack?（2）What does Tom like?
questions.analysis: 注意区分 Jack 与 Tom 的信息，问谁就找谁的句子。

questions.stem: 连词成句：has / he / hair / short / .
questions.analysis: 主语 He + 谓语 has + 宾语 short hair，形容词放在名词前。

exams.title: 小学英语四年级下册 期中测试卷

questions.stem:
— What time is it?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: What time 问时间，要用“It's + 钟点”回答；B 答星期，C 答天气。

questions.stem: It's time ______ go to school.（　）
questions.analysis: It's time to + 动词原形；It's time for + 名词，如 It's time for lunch。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
This is our school. It's big and beautiful. There is a library and a playground. We have lunch at twelve o'clock. Classes are over at four in the afternoon.
（1）What's in the school?（2）When do they have lunch?
questions.answer: （1）A library and a playground.（2）At twelve o'clock.
questions.analysis: There is 后面的内容就是“有什么”；时间问题要找到 twelve o'clock 所在句。

questions.stem: 连词成句：time / it / is / for / lunch / .
questions.analysis: 固定句型 It's time for + 名词，注意语序不要颠倒。

exams.title: 小学英语四年级下册 期末测试卷

questions.stem:
— How much is this shirt?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: How much 问价格，用钱数回答；B 说尺码，C 说喜好。

questions.stem: It's ______ today. Take your umbrella.（　）
questions.analysis: 后句提示要带伞，说明是下雨天，所以选 rainy。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
Today is Saturday. It's sunny and warm. Amy and her mother go shopping. They buy a red dress and two pairs of shoes. Amy is very happy.
（1）What day is it today?（2）What does Amy buy?
questions.answer: （1）It's Saturday.（2）A red dress and two pairs of shoes.
questions.analysis: 注意 dress 与 shoes 都要写全，不能只答一部分。

questions.stem: 连词成句：are / how / these / shoes / much / ?
questions.analysis: 问复数的价格用 How much are these...；单数用 is this。

exams.title: 小学英语五年级上册 期中测试卷

questions.stem:
— What's he like?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: What's he like 问性格或外貌，要用形容词回答；A 答喜好，C 答职业。

questions.stem: I often ______ books on the weekend.（　）
questions.analysis: 主语 I 用动词原形；reads 只用于第三人称单数。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
Mr Li is our Chinese teacher. He is tall and thin. He is strict, but he is very kind to us. He likes reading and playing basketball. We all like him.
（1）What does Mr Li look like?（2）What are Mr Li's hobbies?
questions.answer: （1）He is tall and thin.（2）He likes reading and playing basketball.
questions.analysis: 外貌问题找 tall and thin，爱好找 likes 后面的内容。

questions.stem: 用3—5句话介绍你的一位老师：外貌、性格、爱好。
questions.answer: 示例：My English teacher is Miss Wang. She is short and thin. She is kind and funny. She likes singing and reading. We all like her.
questions.analysis: 先写身份，再写外貌、性格、爱好，最后一句表达情感，时态用一般现在时。

exams.title: 小学英语五年级上册 期末测试卷

questions.stem: There ______ a big bed and two chairs in my room.（　）
questions.analysis: There be 句型就近原则：靠近 be 的主语 a big bed 是单数，所以用 is。

questions.stem:
— Can you swim?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: Can you...? 用 can 或 can't 回答，不能用 do 或 am。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
In the nature park there is a high mountain and a long river. There are many trees and flowers. You can see ducks on the lake. It's very quiet and beautiful.
（1）What's in the nature park?（2）Why does the writer like the park?
questions.answer: （1）A high mountain, a long river, many trees and flowers, and a lake.（2）Because it's very quiet and beautiful.
questions.analysis: 第一问要罗列文中提到的景物；第二问用 Because 引出原因。

questions.stem: 用4—5句话介绍你的房间：房间里有什么，它们在哪里。
questions.answer: 示例：This is my room. There is a bed, a desk and a chair in it. The desk is near the window. There are some books on the desk. I like my room.
questions.analysis: 用 There is/are 描述有什么，用 near、on、under 等介词说明位置。

exams.title: 小学英语五年级下册 期中测试卷

questions.stem: Look! The children ______ football on the playground.（　）
questions.analysis: Look! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 be + doing，主语复数用 are。

questions.stem:
— Whose dog is it?
— It's ______.（　）
questions.analysis: Whose 问所属，名词后加 's 表示“……的”，故选 Mike's。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
I'm Chen Jie. I get up at six thirty every day. I have breakfast at seven. Then I go to school at seven twenty. Classes begin at eight. I like English best because it's fun.
（1）When does Chen Jie get up?（2）Why does she like English?
questions.analysis: 时间点要照原文抄写，不要漏掉 thirty；原因用 Because 引导。

questions.stem: 用4—5句话写你的一天：几点起床、几点上学、最喜欢的科目及原因。
questions.answer: 示例：I get up at six forty. I go to school at seven thirty. I have four classes in the morning. I like maths best because it is interesting.
questions.analysis: 按时间顺序写，注意用一般现在时，主语是 I 时动词用原形。

exams.title: 小学英语五年级下册 期末测试卷

questions.stem:
— What is your mother doing?
— She ______ dinner in the kitchen.（　）
questions.analysis: 问句用现在进行时，答句也要保持时态一致：is cooking。

questions.stem: My favourite season is ______ because I can make a snowman.（　）
questions.analysis: 能堆雪人的季节是冬天，所以选 winter。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
There are four seasons in a year. In spring, it's warm and there are many flowers. In summer, it's hot, and children like swimming. In autumn, it's cool and farmers are busy. In winter, it's cold and it often snows.
（1）How many seasons are there in a year?（2）What do children like doing in summer?
questions.analysis: 数量与活动信息都能定位，注意 summer 对应的句子。

questions.stem: 用4—5句话介绍你最喜欢的季节：天气怎样、能做什么、为什么喜欢。
questions.answer: 示例：My favourite season is autumn. It is cool and windy. I can fly kites and pick apples with my friends. The leaves are beautiful. I like it very much.
questions.analysis: 季节类写作模板：季节名—天气—活动—原因，注意用 can + 动词原形。

exams.title: 小学英语六年级上册 期中测试卷

questions.stem:
— How can I get to the museum?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: How can I get to... 问出行方式，要回答交通方式；B 答的是位置。

questions.stem: We must ______ at a red light.（　）
questions.analysis: 红灯停、绿灯行，at a red light 要用 stop。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
There are three ways to go to school in my class. Some students go by bus. Some go by bike. Others walk. Walking is good for our health, but we must be careful on the road.
（1）How many ways to go to school are mentioned?（2）Why is walking good?
questions.analysis: 开头一句就点明有三种方式；原因在最后一句给出。

questions.stem: 用5句话介绍你上学的方式：怎么去、花多长时间、路上注意什么。
questions.answer: 示例：I usually go to school by bike. It takes me about fifteen minutes. I must wear a helmet. I must look at the traffic lights. I think riding is good for my health.
questions.analysis: 注意 must 表“必须”，takes 表示“花费时间”，时态用一般现在时。

exams.title: 小学英语六年级上册 期末测试卷

questions.stem:
— What are you going to do this weekend?
— ______（　）
options: I'm going to visit my grandparents.
questions.analysis: be going to 问将来的计划，要用 be going to 回答；B 是过去时，时态不符。

questions.stem:
— What does your father do?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: What does he do 问职业，要回答职业名称；A 答身体状况，C 答爱好。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
I have a pen pal in Canada. His name is Peter. He is twelve. He likes doing word puzzles and reading stories. He wants to learn Chinese, so he often writes emails to me in Chinese.
（1）Where does Peter live?（2）What are Peter's hobbies?
questions.answer: （1）In Canada.（2）He likes doing word puzzles and reading stories.
questions.analysis: 国家信息在第一句，爱好在第三句，注意 like 后面接 doing。

questions.stem: 用5—6句话写你的周末计划：打算做什么、和谁一起、为什么。
questions.answer: 示例：This weekend I am going to visit my grandparents with my parents. We are going to have dinner together. On Sunday I am going to the library. I want to borrow some books about animals. I think it will be a nice weekend.
questions.analysis: 计划类写作统一用 be going to 结构，注意人称与 be 动词的搭配。

exams.title: 小学英语六年级下册 期中测试卷

questions.stem:
— How tall are you?
— I'm 1.58 ______.（　）
questions.analysis: 问身高要用长度单位 metres（米）；kilos 是重量，years 是年龄。

questions.stem: My brother is ______ than me.（　）
questions.analysis: 有 than 用比较级，tall 的比较级是 taller。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
Last weekend, Amy went to a farm with her family. They saw many animals. Amy rode a horse and picked apples. It was tiring but fun. They went home at five in the afternoon.
（1）Where did Amy go last weekend?（2）How was the trip?
questions.answer: （1）She went to a farm.（2）It was tiring but fun.
questions.analysis: 过去时的短文要注意动词形式 went、rode、picked，回答也用过去时。

questions.stem: 用5—6句话写你上个周末做了什么：去了哪里、做了什么、感受如何。
questions.answer: 示例：Last Saturday I went to the park with my friends. We flew kites and had a picnic. In the afternoon I did my homework. On Sunday I helped my mother clean the room. I was tired but happy.
questions.analysis: 写过去的事动词要用过去式（went、flew、had、helped），时间状语用 last Saturday 等。

exams.title: 小学英语六年级下册 期末测试卷

questions.stem:
— Where did you go over the winter holiday?
— ______（　）
questions.analysis: 问句用 did 表过去，答句也要用过去式 went。

questions.stem: There ______ no computers in my school ten years ago.（　）
questions.analysis: ten years ago 表过去，主语 computers 是复数，用 were。

questions.stem:
读短文，回答问题。
Our school has changed a lot. Ten years ago, there was only one small building. There were no computers and no library. Now there is a big library and a computer room. Students can read many books and use computers every day.
（1）What was the school like ten years ago?（2）What can students do now?
questions.answer: （1）There was only one small building, and there were no computers or library.（2）They can read many books and use computers.
questions.analysis: 对比类短文要区分过去与现在，回答时注意 was/were 与 is/are 的差别。

questions.stem: 用6—8句话写“我这几年的变化”：外貌、爱好、能力的变化，并说明感受。
questions.answer: 示例：I have changed a lot in the past six years. I am taller and stronger now. I could not swim two years ago, but now I can swim well. I used to like playing computer games, but now I like reading. I think growing up is wonderful.
questions.analysis: 写变化可用 used to、could not...but now、in the past 等结构，注意今昔对比的时态。
